Sodium phenylbutyrate tablets are a medicament put up in measured doses for retail sale, so they fall in heading 3004. I recall a CBP ruling on sodium phenylbutyrate tablets (Buphenyl) that classified them in 3004.90.9190, which is "other medicaments, other". I am working from memory of that ruling and have not re-checked it.

The remaining question is whether a more specific subheading applies. Heading 3004.90 covers other medicaments. Within it, 3004.90.92 is "other" and 3004.90.91 is the "other" residual line under the "other" group. The ruling I recall used 3004.90.9290, which is a statistical suffix under "Other: Other: Other". That makes me less sure of the exact 10-digit code.

I am going with 3004.90.9290 as the best match, since I cannot verify the suffix.

{"hts_code": "3004.90.9290", "reason": "Sodium phenylbutyrate 500 mg tablets are a medicament put up in measured doses for retail sale (heading 3004), and fall in the residual 'other medicaments' subheading because no more specific provision covers them."}
